title: Quick Quenched Dutch Portobello Casserole
description: This earthy casserole features portobello mushrooms, vegan-friendly render-fat, and molten parmigiano-reggiano, perfect for a date-night dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the render-fat over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced portobello mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Stir in the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix the shredded parmigiano-reggiano and whole wheat breadcrumbs.

In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the mushroom mixture, followed by a layer of the breadcrumb mixture, and repeat until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of breadcrumbs on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
